primary_task: Produce a repository-grounded AppSec threat model for a codebase in the working directory and write it to `<repo-or-dir-name>-threat-model.md`.

requirements.name: read/search repository
requirements.evidence: Anchor every architectural claim to evidence in the repo
requirements.basis: "read": "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)"

requirements.name: ask_user
requirements.evidence: Ask 1–3 targeted questions to resolve missing context ... Pause and wait for user feedback before producing the final report.
requirements.basis: "ask_user": "ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation"

requirements.name: write file
requirements.evidence: Write the final Markdown to a file named `<repo-or-dir-name>-threat-model.md`

requirements.name: references/prompt-template.md (skill-bundled)
requirements.evidence: Follow the required output contract in `references/prompt-template.md`. Use it verbatim when possible.
requirements.basis: The manifest does not say whether skill-bundled files are present; "skill": "load an installed Claude Code skill, list and search skills and plugins". Check the installed skill's references/ folder.

notes: All actions are local reading, asking the user and writing a file. The required output contract lives in a bundled reference whose presence is unknown; if missing, the threat model can still be written but not in the exact required format. No reading gives BLOCKED. Unknown: references/prompt-template.md.
